description: This file defines the class 'EmailsViewImport', which extends 'ViewEdit', responsible for handling the import view of emails in the SuiteCRM email module. It sets options for the view, manages pre-display setup including assigning variables for template rendering, and ensures proper behavior within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: EmailsViewImport
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the email import view in SuiteCRM, including initialization and pre-display configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view with specific display options and sets the type to 'ImportView'.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view before display by assigning template variables such as INBOUND_ID and TEMP_ID based on current user preferences and bean state.
